answer: Counterparty-entropy scoring. Weight is the entropy of distinct counterparties per window; repeats with one peer past quota earn nothing. Internal farm trades score zero: the ledger sums peers, not transactions, so a gale of transfers between two keys adds one unit. Climbing requires unrelated agents outside the cluster, each staking capital plus liveness checks. Faking it means paying strangers to trade, fees both ways; spend scales with peers, not keys. A walnut shell game multiplies shells, not the pea: shadow economy flattens while honest trade, a zephyr rather than a gale, sets the pace.
